operational_issue: The manuscript alternated between an empirical case study and an artifact audit, while repeated provenance caveats obscured the scientific object.
locations_checked: Section 2, especially “Evidence status and paper identity” and Table 1
Appendix B Reproducibility and Artifact Map
reasoning_summary: The revision consistently presents one recorder-relative evidence-audit case-study identity across the title, abstract, introduction, results, and conclusion. It identifies L16/L64 as the two main arms, L32/NFE48 as the reused development control, and the strongest result as the source-reported complete rows being consistent with P*=L for those three profiles. A single up-front provenance rule establishes that empirical quantities are source-reported and cannot be verified locally; subsequent SR/CV labels are generally concise, while expanded local caveats address interpretation-specific limitations. The detailed limitations and artifact boundary are concentrated in the Limitations and Reproducibility sections. Material caveats remain intact, including development-control reuse, composite partition/allocation intervention, absent event semantics and pairing records, incomplete L24/L48 vectors, single-locus L48 support, marginal L24 diagnostics, limited model/task/grid scope, and the absence of cross-recorder or causal evidence. The supplied evidence maps and registry use the same identity and evidence boundary.
